<div class="enthusia-wiki">
<p>Open a category to find the command you need. Aliases and closely related variants are grouped together so the page stays searchable without repeating the same action several times.</p>
<details class="enthusia-drop drop command-drop"><summary><b>Getting around</b><span>homes, TPA, spawn and bed</span></summary><div><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><tbody><tr><td><code>/spawn</code></td><td>Teleport to spawn.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/sethome &lt;name&gt;</code></td><td>Set a personal home.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/home [name]</code></td><td>Teleport to a home. Use <code>/homes</code> to view your homes and <code>/delhome &lt;name&gt;</code> to remove one.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/bed</code></td><td>Teleport to your Minecraft bed-spawn location.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/tpa &lt;player&gt;</code></td><td>Ask to teleport to another player.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/tpahere &lt;player&gt;</code></td><td>Ask another player to teleport to you.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/tpaccept [player]</code> / <code>/tpadeny [player]</code></td><td>Accept or deny an incoming request. Common yes/no aliases are also supported by the teleport command set.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/tpacancel</code></td><td>Cancel your outgoing teleport request.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/tpignore &lt;player|list&gt;</code></td><td>Ignore a player's TPA requests or view your TPA ignore list.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/tptoggle</code></td><td>Toggle whether you accept normal TPA requests.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></details>
<details class="enthusia-drop drop command-drop"><summary><b>Chat & social</b><span>private messages, channels and preferences</span></summary><div><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><tbody><tr><td><code>/msg &lt;player&gt; &lt;message&gt;</code></td><td>Send a private message. Aliases include <code>/w</code>, <code>/tell</code> and <code>/whisper</code>.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/r &lt;message&gt;</code></td><td>Reply to the player you most recently messaged or who most recently messaged you. Alias: <code>/reply</code>.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/msgtoggle</code></td><td>Toggle private messages.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/ignore &lt;player&gt;</code></td><td>Ignore chat/messages from a player.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/channel</code></td><td>View or change chat channels. Alias: <code>/c</code>.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/chatcolor</code></td><td>Manage your available chat color. Use <code>/colorcodes</code> to view supported codes.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/emoji</code></td><td>View available chat emoji. Alias: <code>/emojis</code>.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/togglesound</code></td><td>Toggle supported chat notification sounds.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/mail</code></td><td>Use the server mail system.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/report</code></td><td>Report a player or problem through the in-game report command.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></details>
<details class="enthusia-drop drop command-drop"><summary><b>Economy & voting</b><span>Raw Gold, balances and votes</span></summary><div><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><tbody><tr><td><code>/balance</code></td><td>Show total wealth, bank balance and physical Raw Gold. Alias: <code>/bal</code>.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/deposit [amount|all]</code></td><td>Deposit a specific amount of physical Raw Gold, or deposit all of it.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/withdraw &lt;amount&gt;</code></td><td>Withdraw bank balance as physical Raw Gold.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/pay &lt;player&gt; &lt;amount&gt;</code></td><td>Pay another player.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/baltop [page]</code></td><td>Open the balance leaderboard.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/vote</code></td><td>Open voting information. Use <code>/votesites</code> to list vote sites.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></details>
<details class="enthusia-drop drop command-drop"><summary><b>Guilds & groups</b><span>guild management, homes and group chat</span></summary><div><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><tbody><tr><td><code>/guild</code></td><td>Open the guild system. <details class="enthusia-drop drop command-drop"><summary><b>Warzone & Death Duels</b><span>PvP information and duel actions</span></summary><div><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><tbody><tr><td><code>/warzone</code></td><td>Open the Warzone menu.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/warzone info</code></td><td>Show the active Warzone setup.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/warzone modifiers</code></td><td>Show active modifiers; <code>/warzone modifier list</code> browses configured modifiers.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/warzone kit</code> / <code>kits</code></td><td>View the current kit or browse kits.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/warzone items</code></td><td>Show current Warzone item restrictions.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/warzone next</code> / <code>schedule</code></td><td>Show the next rotation change or schedule.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/duel &lt;player&gt;</code></td><td>Challenge a player to a Death Duel.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/duel review</code></td><td>Review an incoming duel, then use <code>/duel accept</code> or <code>/duel deny</code>.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/duel info</code> / <code>settings</code></td><td>View the selected duel rules.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/draw</code></td><td>Request a mutual duel draw.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/vault</code></td><td>Open unclaimed duel spoils.
